summary:
**Project Summary: Astronaut Health Monitoring Software**

The project aims to develop a smart **Astronaut Health Monitoring System** that continuously tracks astronauts' physical and mental health during long-duration space missions. It collects important health indicators such as heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen levels, body temperature, sleep patterns, bone health, and stress levels.
The software analyzes this data using AI to identify unusual health changes, detect potential medical risks, and provide early warnings. It also offers personalized health recommendations, emergency alerts, and health reports to help astronauts monitor their condition and take appropriate action.
details: Main objective: To ensure astronauts remain physically and mentally healthy, reduce medical risks, and support safer, longer space missions through real-time health monitoring and AI-based analysis.
